verdict.rationale: Working Copy is an iOS Git client, and a tool like this could plausibly publish an official MCP server for agents to reach its repositories, so the axis applies. The pack documents a built-in Repository Agent, Shortcuts, x-callback-url and a WebDAV server, but none of these is an MCP server. Probes for agent-facing artifacts (llms.txt, OpenAPI) all returned 404, and nothing shows an official MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
